annotation.authors_or_issuer: Kementerian Koordinator Bidang Pembangunan Manusia dan Kebudayaan (Kemenko PMK)
key_provisions_or_claims: Ministerial-level meeting agreed to formulate a National Strategy for Integrated AI Education and Human Resource Development
A National Task Force involving multiple ministries and agencies will be formed
Three-layer action: educate all citizens to use AI wisely, develop AI developers and AI-preneurs, and strengthen the ecosystem for R&D and investment
Emphasis on Indonesian AI sovereignty using Indonesian data, ideology and culture
Warns AI is not neutral and can serve defence, security and ideological purposes
annotation.summary_en: Indonesian Coordinating Ministry for Human Development and Culture press item on a ministerial meeting (29 April 2025) agreeing to draft a National Strategy for Integrated AI Education and HR Development and form a national task force, stressing wise AI use, talent development and Indonesian AI sovereignty.
annotation.title_clean: Kemenko PMK Inisiasi Satgas Strategi Nasional AI Terintegrasi
annotation.title_en: Kemenko PMK Initiates Task Force for Integrated National AI Strategy
